item.title: Catching a Ferry
item.description: Read ferry announcements and signs to find out when the ferry leaves, where to wait, and how to get on and off.

children.definition: The whole place on land where people start or finish a trip by ferry, including the buildings and waiting areas.
children.example: The north ferry terminal has a separate entrance for cars.

children.definition: A trip by boat from one side of a river, lake or sea to the other.
children.example: The crossing takes 35 minutes from the mainland to the island.
children.translation_uz: kema yoki qayiqda suvning bir tomonidan ikkinchi tomoniga borish safari

children.definition: To get onto a ship at the start of a trip.
children.example: Please have your ticket ready before you embark at Pier 2.

children.definition: To get off a ship after it stops.
children.example: Please wait until the ferry has stopped completely before you disembark.

children.definition: A marked lane where drivers line up and wait before driving onto a ferry.
children.example: After the ticket check, pull into holding lane 3 and wait for a signal from the crew.

children.definition: A large indoor room where people can sit until it is time to get on a ferry.
children.example: Please stay in the waiting hall until staff call passengers travelling without a car.

children.definition: The deck of a ferry where cars, vans and trucks are parked during the trip.
children.example: The crew will tell you when you can go down to the vehicle deck to collect your car.

children.definition: A short written message from the ferry company about a change that affects passengers.
children.example: A service notice on the terminal screen says the island ferry will leave 20 minutes late.
children.translation_ru: уведомление об изменениях в движении паромов

children.definition: Used when a planned trip will no longer take place.
children.example: The 10:30 ferry is cancelled, so please check the screen for the next departure.

children.definition: A fixed structure that extends from the shore over the water and has space for people to walk on it.
children.example: Follow the signs to the end of the pier, where the island ferry picks up passengers.
children.translation_uz: qirgʻoqdan suv ustiga choʻzilgan, odamlar ustida yura oladigan inshoot

children.definition: The exact spot in a port where a ship stops and is tied in place.
children.example: Keep waiting by the terminal doors until the ferry is tied up at berth 4.

children.definition: A sloping surface that cars and trucks use to drive onto or off a ferry.
children.example: Wait for the green light before driving down the ramp and onto the ferry.
children.translation_ru: аппарель для въезда транспорта на паром и съезда с него
children.translation_uz: transport vositalari paromga chiqib-tushadigan qiya yoʻlak

children.definition: A narrow walkway put in place so people can walk between the shore and a ship.
children.example: When a crew member waves you forward, walk across the gangway and into the ferry.

children.definition: The final ferry departure on a particular route that day.
children.example: The last sailing to the mainland leaves at 9 p.m. tonight.
collocations: the last sailing of the day
